messages.language_question: Which language should your brain speak?
messages.intro: About 10 minutes: mostly clicks, a few short answers. Skip anything you like.
messages.drive_why: A cloud drive keeps your brain backed up and lets you use it from your phone.
messages.drive_move: Help me move it to a cloud drive
messages.apps_question: Which of these should your brain read from?
messages.keeper_where_question: Where should the Brain Keeper run?
messages.keeper_cloud: In the cloud, even with my computer off
messages.finish_built: Your brain is ready: {n} folders, your About pages, your projects and the people you named.
messages.finish_open: Open Baalda and open this folder to browse your notes.
messages.finish_daily: Every day, open a chat on this folder and talk normally, for example "I had a call with Marta, here's what we agreed". Your agent files everything in the right place.
messages.finish_keeper: The Brain Keeper tidies your brain every work day at {keeper time}. Say "check up my brain" anytime.
messages.finish_brief: Your morning brief comes at {brief time} on work days. Say "morning brief" anytime.
messages.finish_phone: Your brain is in your cloud drive, so you can use it from your phone.
messages.finish_instructions: Want your agent to talk like this in every chat, not only in your brain? Copy this into your agent's settings.
messages.finish_old_notes: Want me to bring in your old notes now?
messages.finish_extras: You can also say "prep me for Marta", "challenge my idea" or "undo the last change".
messages.instructions_example: Use simple, plain words and no jargon. Keep replies short, no walls of text. Use short lists and examples. Work step by step and check each step before moving on. Do only what I asked.
